item.title: Haitian Migrants, Traffic Police, Power Outages
item.ns0:title: Haitian Migrants, Traffic Police, Power Outages
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, authorities intercept dozens of migrants and a cache of suspected narcotics in waters off Exuma, while the government continues its push for repatriations. We bring you an exclusive look at a former officer’s emotional plea for justice in a cold case involving a police-involved shooting and investigate the growing financial toll of persistent power outages on the local business community. Our team tracks a major police crackdown on dangerous driving and brings you the latest on the high-stakes standoff surrounding a controversial demolition project in Grand Bahama. Plus, we cover critical new steps for special needs education in the country and celebrate the veteran Bahamian stars making their mark on the international sports stage.
